'''Five-Card Draw''' is a [[Challenge Deck]]. Its small hand size can be supplemented by the additional discards in order to find and play the same hand multiple times.

== Starting Contents ==
The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards.

== Synergies ==
===[[Jokers]]===
* Generic {{Mult|+}} Jokers like {{J|Half Joker}} and {{J|Gros Michel}} can help you push through the early antes.
* Jokers that benefit from the extra Joker slots, like {{J|Abstract Joker}}, {{J|Riff-Raff}}, and {{J|Joker Stencil}}.
* Jokers that benefit from the extra discards, like {{J|Banner}} and {{J|Delayed Gratification}}.
* {{J|Blackboard}} becomes much easier to activate due to the small hand size.
* Strong {{xMult|}} Jokers that aren't reliant on hand type, such as {{J|Hologram}}, {{J|Constellation}}, and {{J|Cavendish}}.
* {{J|Blue Joker}} gives slightly more chips due to drawing fewer cards from your deck.
* {{J|Yorick}} is amazing in this challenge, as the increased discards mean it can consistently gain {{XMult|1}} every blind with the use of 5 discards.
* {{J|Raised Fist}} can have a better score from the reduced hand size, as it's easier to hold onto high-ranked cards.
* Effect Jokers that provide no direct scoring, such as {{J|Splash}}, {{J|Shortcut}} or {{J|Luchador}}, become easier to keep thanks to the extra 2 Joker Slots.

===[[Vouchers]]===
* {{v|Paint Brush}} and {{v|Palette}} can be used to increase your hand size in this challenge.

===[[Tags]]===
* {{Tag|Juggle}} can give a temporary hand size for the player. This can help on certain situations where the normal hand size of this challenge isn't enough.
* {{Tag|Garbage}} will give more money for unused discards.

===[[Consumables]]===
*The value of {{Tarot|Temperance}} rises from two extra Jokers.

===Boss Blinds===
*{{Blind|The House}} becomes less deadly since only 5 cards are drawn face down.

== Anti-Synergies ==
===Jokers===
* Held in hand effects such as {{J|Baron}} and {{J|Shoot the Moon}} are less effective due to the decreased hand size and banning of hand size-increasing Jokers.
*Straight-based Jokers, such as {{J|Runner}}, {{J|Crazy Joker}}, and {{J|The Order}}, becomes much harder to use due to the decreased hand size, which makes it extremely hard to assemble Straights.
**On a similar note, {{J|Séance}} requires playing a Straight Flush, which is practically impossible with a hand size of 5.
*{{J|Stuntman}} and {{J|Merry Andy}} should be avoided, as their reduced hand size penalty will make it impossible to play 5-card poker hands.
*{{J|Burglar}} is very risky to use, as its 3 extra hands do not benefit too much, unlike the 3 extra discards already provided by this challenge.
*{{J|Mystic Summit}} becomes harder to activate due to the extra discards.
*{{J|Green Joker}} and {{J|Ramen}} do not benefit too much from the extra discards.

===Consumables===
*{{Spectral|Ectoplasm}} shouldn't be used, as its permanent hand size reduction will make certain hands impossible to assemble, and the player already has 2 extra Joker Slots, making it less valuable.
*{{Spectral|Sigil}} and {{Spectral|Ouija}} will transform fewer cards due to the small hand size. Not only that, but {{Spectral|Ouija}} also reduces hand size, making it significantly more punishing to use.

===[[Modifiers]]===
*The decreased hand size doesn't allow many {{Enhancement|Gold}}, {{Enhancement|Steel}}, and {{Seal|Blue|name=Blue Seals}} to be utilized.

===Blinds===
*{{Blind|The Manacle}}'s reduced hand size can be dangerous, as it will prevent the player from playing 5-card poker hands.
*If the player reduces hand size even by one (assuming they didn't redeem {{V|Paint Brush}}), {{Blind|The Psychic}} will become unbeatable.

== Trivia ==
*Five-Card Draw brings ''Balatro'' closer to [[Wikipedia:Five-card draw|the popular poker variant of the same name]], where players are dealt five cards in their hand and are able to discard and replace many of these easily.
